look_here_first: Count the leaflets and inspect a samara. Mexican ash usually has 3–5 leaflets with coarse sharp serration toward the tips; samara wings expand gradually from near the base, and occasional 3-winged fruits can occur.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: samara wings gradually expand from near the base and narrowly flange the fruit body

lookalikes.differences: Green ash generally carries more leaflets and has a broader shield-shaped scar with differently broadened samaras; Texas ash tends to have 5–7 leaflets, a glaucous lower surface, and smaller mostly terminal-winged samaras.
